summary: Conditional two-channel 16-bit read. Calls ShortComputation_adb0(this + 108) and only proceeds when that result is greater than 2. Then performs two indexed reads through LinkedListIndexedFieldReader: channel index 0 writes two shorts to *a2/*a3, channel index 1 writes two shorts to *a4/*a5. Each pair of output writes is gated on the corresponding read returning nonzero.

operations.description: Call ShortComputation_adb0(this + 108) to obtain a gating value.
Guard: only proceed when the ShortComputation result is greater than 2.
First channel read: LinkedListIndexedFieldReader(0, &v8, &v9) fills two 16-bit locals.
Guard: when the first channel read returns nonzero, publish its two shorts.
Publish first-channel values: *a2 = v8 and *a3 = v9.
Second channel read: LinkedListIndexedFieldReader(1, &v8, &v9) refills the two 16-bit locals.
Guard: when the second channel read returns nonzero, publish its two shorts.
Publish second-channel values: *a4 = v8 and *a5 = v9.
Return result, which after a successful second read is set to the address of a4 rather than a value from the reads.
Called by ConditionalMultiParamDispatch (0x004861A0) as the two-channel 16-bit reader variant.

unresolved: Return value semantics are ambiguous: after a successful second read the function returns the a4 output pointer, otherwise it returns the initial ShortComputation result or the second read result.
Meaning of the ShortComputation_adb0(this + 108) > 2 gate is unknown.
Semantics of the two channels and the meaning of the two 16-bit values produced per channel are unknown.
